turns.text: Hi. The print was delivered to the old flat. I'd like to change the delivery address on that order now.

I'm sorry about that. Under our policy, a delivery address can only be changed until the order ships, so I can't change it for an order that has already been delivered. I've passed your case to a colleague, who will take over and help you with this. It will help if you have your order number and the email on the order ready.

rule.ro: Adresa de livrare se poate schimba până la expedierea comenzii. Schimbarea trebuie aprobată de echipă.
rule.en: The delivery address can change until the order ships. Staff must approve the change.
